name: Anchor Charm
description: Revives a downed ally with 30 Resolve.

name: Splice
description: A patch cable and a habit. Clears Target Lock and Bound by terms from one ally. Nothing else in the field can.

name: Steady
description: A flask of something warm and a hand on the shoulder. Clears Fear from one ally. Nothing else in the field can.

name: Chronal Dampener
description: A Founders-era coil that hums the wrong way. Lowers Entropy by 20 in a fight, and keeps an Echo from answering.

name: Faraday Foil
description: A sheet of mesh the whole party stands under. Two turns of Faraday for everyone: no Signal, no Thermal damage at all.

name: Drone Scrap
description: Crafting parts. Nobody in Kell buys these. Yet.
